statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Weekend closure leaves current Tail at 19% while verified Gulf energy-route disruption keeps Stress at 100%.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains below WATCH because live NQ price-path persistence cannot be observed during the weekend closure.
headline: Weekend closure keeps Tail low while Gulf energy-route Stress remains extreme
body: NQ futures remain closed. A verified Strait of Hormuz vessel strike, the Saudi East-West pipeline disruption and Bab el-Mandeb pressure keep Stress at 100%. These are material reopening-gap catalysts, but without observed one-way NQ structure they do not establish pathological mean-reversion failure.
